interpretation: There is no exact normalized prompt or full-conversation leakage across the train, validation, and test partitions.
Most high-similarity cross-split pairs are systems questions that share long source context but ask different questions.
No training prompt reached 0.90 similarity to the three common benchmark catalogs, but manual review found lower-similarity transformed HumanEval and MBPP-style examples.
Cluster-aware splitting and removal of benchmark derivatives would strengthen publication-grade evaluation.
